# PrecedenceOptions

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Settings of the precedence models. Each is optional in a document.

Appears at: `/policy/precedence_options`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_tiebreak` | [`AllowTiebreak`](types.md#allowtiebreak) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Which allow decides when several allow rules of different kinds could (`deny_wins`, `allow_wins` and `specificity`). The default, `most_restrictive`, ranks `allow_contained` over `allow` over `allow_elevated`. |
| `curated_first` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | `first_match` only: rules of curated (read-only) rule sets are evaluated before every custom rule, whatever their `order`. On by default. |
| `granularity_tiebreak` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | `allow_wins` only: within one rule set, a rule with a more specific identity beats a less specific one before allow-over-deny applies, so a denied file in an allowed folder stays denied. Off by default. |
| `priority_direction` | [`PriorityDirection`](types.md#prioritydirection) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | `priority` only: whether the lowest or the highest `priority` number wins. `lower_wins` by default. |
| `same_tier_tiebreak` | [`TierTiebreak`](types.md#tiertiebreak) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | `specificity` only: which action wins between rules of the same specificity. `deny` by default. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
